rulesTestNames: lets the event's managers and booked guests get its room layout and nothing else
owner: Event-success read model projector: eventSuccess layoutViewTriggers
read: get by event id for the event's organizer managers and for a guest whose own eventBookings row is signedUp or attended or whose own eventRuntimeParticipants row is ready, as getEventSuccessSpatialLayout admitted them; a view not written yet reads as missing; never listed
write: server only; written from eventSuccessPlans and organizerEventSuccessLayouts
migrationNotes: Replaces getEventSuccessSpatialLayout for the Catch app (#2306): the selected layout exactly as the callable projected it (publicEventSuccessLayout). The guest-event-day-views copy-forward migration creates views for events that predate the triggers.
No personal data: room geometry and the organizer's layout label.
